pkgmetadata.longdescription: FreeBASIC is an open-source, multi-platform BASIC compiler (fbc) with syntax similar to Microsoft QuickBASIC. It adds pointers, object orientation, unsigned types, inline assembly, and bindings for many third-party libraries. The compiler is written in FreeBASIC. A first install uses dev-lang/freebasic-bootstrap; rebuilds use the installed fbc.
